newsitem.title: UK: EMTA suggests debt markets close for holidays.
newsitem.headline: EMTA suggests debt markets close for holidays.

text.p: The Emerging Markets Traders Association (EMTA) said in a statement the emerging debt market in Britain should be closed on August 25, a public holiday in the UK.

It has also advised its members that emerging market debt trading in the U.S. should remain open until 1400 New York time on August 29 and should be closed on September 1, the U.S. Labour Day public holiday.
